notes.title: New Demo is live!
notes.content:
Discover the latest updates in Star Ores Inc. today!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648844/e1530e83d6c9054637438069011acc46fb331655.gif"]



After a successful playtest and several days of intense work analyzing your feedback and polishing the demo, it’s finally here:



The new demo version is now available! So: power up your laser and head into the mine!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648844/22cd0c4345ad0f4d7c17056cd1f750ec5850879d.png"]

 

🏗️ New Buildings

For the first time, you can unlock buildings in the demo!

Use the Smelt-O-Tron to refine ore into ore bars

Automate ore mining with the Drill



🪨 Discover Karnite

A new mineral awaits in the expanded mine: Karnite  
It’s significantly more valuable than regular ore and can be sold for a higher price.

 

🪴 Decorate Your Station

You can now unlock and build decorations to beautify your station and mine and they offer additional effects too.

 

💾 Save Your Progress

You can now save your game!  
Up to three save slots are available in the demo.

 

🤖 More Robots

Discover and repair new helpers to assist with transporting materials.

 

💥 Improved Mining

Many of you felt the mining was too monotonous. That’s why we’ve upgraded the system with the following:

Weak spots on rocks that speed up mining

No more holding down the laser button

Progress is no longer reset when interrupted (only slowed down for minerals)

 

⚙️ Additional Improvements

Alongside the major changes, we’ve added some quality-of-life updates:

Jumping, running, crawling are now possible

XP system reworked with more ways to earn XP

Partial deliveries are rewarded that means you’ll earn money if you can at least complete one of the requests

 

🐞 Bugfixes, Bugfixes, Bugfixes

Thanks to your help, we’ve fixed numerous bugs, including the “start blocker” bug that prevented some players from getting into the game.



 

We hope you enjoy the new demo! Just like last time, we’d love if you could take a few minutes to fill out our survey.



 

Now have fun playing, and don’t forget to add Star Ores Inc. to your Wishlist 😉

Galactic greetings,



Alex & David

BlackBeak Games

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648844/92ef577c4b9fcecca1652046f6be23be49f372cb.png"]



💬 Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/VYZV4GyY

notes.title: The demo is here! Begin your journey in Star Ores Inc. today.
notes.content:
Heads up, Space Miners!




[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45648844/6f507ec0dfb02370df4546bec57f460fe16cfc8e.png"]


First of all, a huge thank-you to all the playtesters who helped us get the Star Ores Inc. demo ready for today!





Because the time has come: the first playable demo of Star Ores Inc. is now live!





Grab your D64 laser and explore your very own Star Ores Inc. mine. Drill through rock, extract valuable ore, sell it to customers — and who knows, you might just meet your first robot helper along the way.





This demo is just the beginning — we’re super excited to hear your feedback on performance, gameplay, and everything in between. Feel free to reach out via the Community Hub or join us on Discord!





🛒 Play the demo now and add us to your wishlist:


[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3613270/Star_Ores_Inc/"][/dynamiclink]


Thanks so much for your support — we can’t wait to see how you shake up our little ore-filled world! 🚀💚








Cheers,


Alex & David





BlackBeak Games





💬 Join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/WpxwA9B8G3
